title: hunterkill
description: In HunterKill’s survival chase, hunters track with strength sticks and compasses; runners evade with knockback sticks, winning by slaying the Ender Dragon, while hunters triumph by eliminating all runners (respawning infinitely but losing gear).
body:
**High performance, fast, fun, mini game, extremely high compatibility, minimal footprint!**
# English Description​
HunterKill is a Spigot plugin for Minecraft 1.12.2 to 1.16.5 designed to create a competitive chase-style minigame. Its core purpose is to pit two teams against each other: hunters and runners. Hunters are equipped with strength-boosted sticks for combat and compasses (with a 1-second cooldown) to track the nearest runners. Runners receive knockback sticks to evade pursuit. The gameplay loop revolves around runners surviving to defeat the Ender Dragon (they are eliminated on death) while hunters aim to eliminate all runners to win—hunters can respawn infinitely but lose their gear each time they die. Admins set up teams via commands, and the game starts after a 5-second countdown, with the ability to end it early.​
# 中文描述​
HunterKill 是一款适用于 Minecraft 1.12.2-1.16.5 的 Spigot 插件，旨在打造一款竞争性的追逐类迷你游戏。其核心目标是让两支队伍展开对抗：猎人和逃跑者。猎人配备有力量增强的木棍用于战斗，以及带有 1 秒冷却时间的指南针来追踪最近的逃跑者；逃跑者则获得击退木棍用于躲避追击。玩法核心为：逃跑者需存活至击败末影龙即可获胜（死亡即被淘汰），而猎人需淘汰所有逃跑者赢得胜利 —— 猎人可无限复活，但每次死亡会掉落装备。管理员通过命令设置队伍后，游戏将在 5 秒倒计时后开始，且可随时提前结束。
